text:
Marta: FYI I opened a tiny PR to clean up terminology in the Reserved Capacity handbook and to fix an eviction link that kept tripping up reviewers. https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4401
Ibrahim: thanks. what's the terminology change? are we renaming reserved -> dedicated or the other way around? customers already mix them up.
Marta: goal is to use "reserved pool" consistently for tenant-allocated capacity and avoid the word "dedicated" except for Dedicated product SKU. keeps handbook and product doc boundaries clear.
Yuki: +1. could we add a short glossary line at the top: reserved pool = tenant-reserved GPUs; Dedicated = Redwood Dedicated offering (contracted). One-liner prevents future conflation.
Sam: also saw a broken runtime link in the eviction subsection that pointed to /runtime/evict-old-matrix. infra moved it; new path is /runtime/eviction-matrix. can we update and add a one-line summary so readers don't have to click?
Marta: added the updated URL in the PR and a concise summary: "Tenant isolation favors allocation but does not prevent host-level preemption." short and to the point.
Ibrahim: can you include a tiny priority table? people like quick visuals. e.g.: Reserved pool (tenant) > Dedicated cluster > Shared cluster; note: host pressure can override.
Marta: added a two-row table and a short example showing when requests spill: if reserved pool usage >= pool capacity and fallback policy allows burst -> requests go to Dedicated then Shared.
Yuki: suggestion for SLA paragraph: replace vague "best-effort" wording with exact phrase "no SLA for burst capacity". legal asked us to be explicit.
Marta: swapped wording accordingly. also moved runnable snippets (CLI + terraform + SDK) into /examples/reservations/ per docs conventions. reviewers liked that.
Sam: can you paste the CLI example here for quick review?
Marta: sure: `redwood reserve create --name team-x --gpus 4 --isolation tenant --policy burst`
Sam: looks good. also please ensure the terraform snippet includes `isolation = "tenant"` and a comment about eviction not being absolute. small example: ```hcl
resource "redwood_reserved_pool" "team_x" {
  name = "team-x-pool"
  gpus = 4
  isolation = "tenant" # allocation preference, not an anti-eviction guarantee
}
```
Ibrahim: added one inline nit: prefer the phrase "reserved pool" rather than "tenant pool" in the handbook to match other pages.
Yuki: will do a quick sweep for wording consistency. small style rule: avoid mixing hyphenation (reserved-pool vs reserved pool). pick one.
doc-bot: checklist generated - update eviction link, add glossary line, replace "best-effort" with "no SLA for burst capacity", move runnable examples to /examples/reservations/, include CLI + terraform + SDK snippets, add priority table, run link-checker.
Marta: thanks all 8077; will push the split examples and the glossary change tonight and request reviews from Yuki + Ibrahim. will ping when merged so Docs can backport to release-1.3.
Ibrahim: thanks. leaving one final comment around linking to the Console SLO dashboard (paste the URL in the PR) so customers know where to observe latency.
Marta: pasted Console URL in PR comments. closing when merged. :rocket:
